items.label: master alloy
items.quote: To prepare the master alloy, mixture of zinc and phosphorous with atomic proportions 11:9 were poured into a quartz tube, and then the tube was repeatedly rotated, turned and shaken to thoroughly mix the powder.

items.label: A1

items.purpose: heating treatment of the sealed quartz tubes
items.quote: Thermal analysis experiments had previously indicated that at 500 °C zinc and phosphorous react to form phosphides of zinc [31], so a heating rate of 50 °C/h was used with isothermal segments at 500 °C(18 h), 900 °C (10 h) and 1100 °C (5 h) while heating treatment of the sealed quartz tubes.
